Jeong Bo-young Hangul 정보영 RR Jeong Boyeong MR Chŏng Poyŏng Jeong Bo-young ( Korean : 정보영 , born 21 May 2003) is a South Korean professional tennis player. Jeong has a career-high singles ranking of 558 by the WTA , achieved on 8 September 2025. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 444 achieved on 17 February 2025. [ 1 ] Jeong made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2022 Korea Open after receiving a wildcard for the singles tournament, losing in the first round to Jelena Ostapenko in three sets.
